methodology.ageBands: Within-position, within-transition tertiles; no outcome-based threshold search.

interactionFormula.expression: 0.75 * within-transition aligned usage rank percentile + 0.25 * within-transition aligned development rank percentile
interactionFormula.note: Weights were fixed before evaluating either historical transition and were not optimized.

methodology.readiness: Requires adequate samples, same-transition improvement, cross-transition agreement, plausible direction, and improvement over the comparable usage-only signal.

marketValueAppreciation.reason: Production-percentile ascent cannot distinguish fantasy production improvement from appreciation relative to acquisition cost; historical ADP or equivalent market data is required.

limitations: Only two historical transitions are available.
Age and career stage are observational context, not causal variables.
Historical ADP and market-value appreciation are unavailable.
SOURCE LIMITATION: no routes, route participation, TPRR, YPRR, or first-read share.
finalDecision: PROMISING DEVELOPMENT SIGNALS — MORE VALIDATION NEEDED
